teaser.subline: Colombia's next great furry carnival. Much more, very soon.
teaser.bannerAlt: Sunfest 2027 illustration: furry characters celebrating carnival on the balcony of a Colombian town, with the Andes and the Colombian flag behind them.

about.title: All of Colombia's carnivals, furry style
about.body: Sunfest 2027 brings together the color of carnivals from across the country in a big Furry Colombia gathering, among the mountains and coffee of Quindío: days of festivity, fursuits and community. Same team as Moonfest, new season.

showcase.title: Your warm corner of the coffee region
showcase.body: Hotel Mocawa Resort is sun, palm trees and turquoise water in the heart of Quindío. Here the warmth of our Colombian land comes back: pool days, mild evenings and carnaval color in every corner.

recap.title: An unforgettable first year
recap.body: Moonfest 2026 was yours: attendees, artists, staff and volunteers. Thank you for every moment under the moon.

cta.title: The best is yet to come!
cta.body: This is only the start. We'll be dropping more Sunfest 2027 surprises very soon. Join the pack, get ready, and don't miss a thing — it's going to be epic!
